text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We lost the last race, but we won't be
repeating
that failure today.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Why are you so stressed out? You look like you're the one about to get sent out there.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Chin up. You're in for a good show
today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Nakayama Festa briskly
leaves the
waiting room.
